# Decision after review round 5 (record 54): name the residue, split a ticket

Asked in this session on 2 October 2026 and answered by Ruud: correct the wording,
name the crossing case as a residue, deliver SEEN-145 with round 5's F1 accepted
on his authority, and open a follow-up ticket for a maximum matching per record.

Round 5's F1: when a later finding's claim matches one earlier finding and its
failure scenario another, every pair ties on texts, line and id, the greedy join
falls through to position, and list order decides whether 2 or 3 findings are
counted. Rounds 2 to 5 each found one more edge of the greedy join; a maximum
matching per record closes the family instead of one more case, and does not
belong in a 1-point ticket on its sixth round.

The work for the next session, no new behaviour and so no new RED:

- harness/calibration.py, the comment over the per-record join: say the order
  is the last resort (note 36) and name the crossing case as the residue the
  greedy join leaves, with the follow-up ticket's id. Same for the
  finding_identities docstring if it claims more.
- harness/tests/test_calibration.py: the docstring of
  test_a_later_record_s_findings_take_their_matches_strongest_first must not say
  the order "decides nothing".
- harness/kpi.py, the findings docstring: name the crossing case beside
  SEEN-006's R-04 as a residue.
- The ticket's Outcome: drop "decides nothing", name the residue and the
  follow-up ticket, and record round 5 (record 54) and this decision (this note).
- A new ticket file, the next free id after SEEN-145, epic E10, at most 2 points,
  depends on SEEN-145: replace the greedy per-record join in
  calibration.finding_identities with a maximum assignment, so listing order
  never changes a count, with round 5's scenario as its first criterion. Add its
  row to docs/tickets/README.md and to the CLAUDE.md index if the index lists
  every ticket. Run `harness guard` on each path first; a path the slice does not
  name is a reason to check whether the guard allows it, not to work around it.
- Then regression and coverage after every edit is final, the tdd advance citing
  the existing RED 47 and GREEN 48 (no behaviour changed), triage, and review
  round 6, whose reviewer is told nothing beyond the triage's task text; F1 of
  round 5 stands accepted by this note.
